name: INS-ask-carrying-a-card
old: if (d.ask === true && d.card === undefined) return { to, ask: true };
new: if (d.ask === true) return { to, ask: true };
note: An ask with a card on it passes as an ask - a frame the wire must refuse whole.

name: INS-level-bound-off-by-one
note: Level 0 is no level a sheet draws.

name: INS-attribute-bound-off-by-one
note: 101 past the live clamp the sheet draws under.

name: INS-short-card-admitted
note: Seven attributes are half a sheet drawn as a whole one.

name: INS-look-unprojected
old: return { level, attrs, vitals, look: validLook(c.look) };
new: return { level, attrs, vitals, look: c.look };
note: A look the room's own law never projected - a field the doll does not know rides along.

name: INS-relay-min-lowered
note: A card asked of world101 (main's DISC12 relay, the last before the arc), which closes the socket for a frame it does not know.

name: INS-frame-cap-dropped
old: if (text.length > CARD_FRAME_MAX) return { error: 'frame too large' };
note: The card frame without its size door.

name: INS-relay-fans-to-the-room
old: this._send(tws, JSON.stringify({ t: 'card', id: a.id, ...(typeof a.sub === 'string' && a.sub ? { sub: a.sub } : {}), data: m.data }));
new: for (const [other, b] of this._all()) if (other !== ws && b.id) this._send(other, JSON.stringify({ t: 'card', id: a.id, ...(typeof a.sub === 'string' && a.sub ? { sub: a.sub } : {}), data: m.data }));
note: An ask or an answer heard by everyone in the room.

name: INS-relay-stamp-missing
old: JSON.stringify({ t: 'card', id: a.id, ...(typeof a.sub === 'string' && a.sub ? { sub: a.sub } : {}), data: m.data })
new: JSON.stringify({ t: 'card', ...(typeof a.sub === 'string' && a.sub ? { sub: a.sub } : {}), data: m.data })
note: A card nobody can say whose it is.

name: INS-relay-channel-carries-it
old:
a = this._meterCard(ws, a, now); if (!a) return;
      if (isChatRoom(a.key) || isSocialRoom(a.key)) return;
new: a = this._meterCard(ws, a, now); if (!a) return;
note: A channel or the hub routes a card - nowhere to stand beside anyone.

name: INS-relay-self-not-junk
note: A card at my own id is junk no longer counted.

name: INS-relay-card-funnel-its-own
old:
// frame (_senderFunnel says why)
      if (!this._senderFunnel(tws, a.id, now)) return;
new:
// frame (_senderFunnel says why)
      { const tm = this._meterOf(tws); const f = tokenGate(tm.kin?.[a.id] ?? null, now, CAST_HZ_MAX); (tm.kin ??= {})[a.id] = f.bucket; if (!f.pass) return; }
note: A second funnel for the card: one sender reaches one destination at twice the rate, a card beside every cast.

name: INS-relay-funnel-skipped
old:
// frame (_senderFunnel says why)
      if (!this._senderFunnel(tws, a.id, now)) return;
note: No funnel onto the destination at all.

name: INS-relay-meter-unstruck
new: 'cardBucket', 'cardDrops', 'too many card frames', Infinity) ? a : null; }
note: A flood of card frames never closes its socket.

name: INS-relay-meter-drops-nothing
old: _meterCard(ws, a, now) { return this._spend(ws, now, cardGate, 'cardBucket', 'cardDrops', 'too many card frames') ? a : null; }
new: _meterCard(ws, a, now) { this._spend(ws, now, cardGate, 'cardBucket', 'cardDrops', 'too many card frames'); return a; }
note: Over the rate the frame goes on anyway - each destination's funnel is then the only bound, and a sender spreads its flood across them.

name: INS-link-version-door-dropped
note: A card sent to a relay that closes the socket for it.

name: INS-link-at-myself
why: sendCard refuses any `to` no open socket of mine reports (_socketFor), and a room never reports my own id - the welcome's roster leaves me out and my own join is never sent back to me - so the self check is belt-and-braces, kept beside the trade and cast senders' identical one.

name: INS-link-gate-dropped
old:
const gate = cardGate(this._cardBucket, this._now());
    if (!gate.pass) return false;
note: The link past CARD_HZ_MAX - the relay would strike it.

name: INS-link-welcome-ignored
note: The welcome's version never read.

name: INS-link-inbound-gate-dropped
note: Every card frame in delivered, however fast a sender floods.

name: INS-link-someone-elses-delivered
old: if (d && d.to === this.id) this._deliver('card', () => this.onCard?.(m.id, d, subOf(m)));
note: A frame addressed to someone else delivered to me.

name: INS-link-my-own-echo
note: My own frame back delivered as a peer's.

name: INS-card-base-stats
note: Base attributes where their sheet shows live ones - a disease's -5 missing.

name: INS-card-fatigue-in-points
note: Fatigue in points, not the sheet's /64 figure.

name: INS-card-look-left-off
note: The card carries a default look, not the one they wear now.

name: INS-answer-every-ask
old: if (at != null && now - at < intervalMs) return false;
note: Every ask answered - a stranger asking every frame makes me send every frame.

name: INS-answer-memory-unbounded
old: if (last.size >= max) last.delete(last.keys().next().value);   // the stalest asker makes room
note: Askers remembered without end.

name: INS-answer-stalest-kept
note: The newest asker forgotten to make room, the stalest kept.

name: INS-view-room-look-first
note: The room's copy of their look preferred to the one they wear now.

name: INS-view-title-off-the-card
note: A title off the card - a claim nobody granted.

name: INS-view-attrs-without-card
old: attrs: card ? STAT_KEYS_ORDER.map((key, i) => ({ key, short: ATTR_SHORT[i], label: ATTR_LABELS[i], value: card.attrs[i] })) : [],
new: attrs: STAT_KEYS_ORDER.map((key, i) => ({ key, short: ATTR_SHORT[i], label: ATTR_LABELS[i], value: card?.attrs[i] ?? 0 })),
note: A sheet of zeros drawn before any card came.

name: INS-gear-out-of-order
note: The gear in the look's own order, not head to foot.

name: INS-window-answer-for-anyone
note: An answer drawn on another player's card.

name: INS-window-escape-under-a-surface
old: if (above()) return;   // a surface over this one owns the key - untouched, unstopped
note: Escape eaten while a surface stands over the card.

name: INS-window-pointer-freed-twice
note: A second card over the first frees the pointer twice.

name: INS-window-covered-kept
note: The card left standing over a window.

name: INS-window-name-size-kept
note: A narrow card keeps the name's full size - the widest name breaks inside itself.

name: INS-menu-row-missing
note: No Inspect row.

name: INS-menu-row-always
note: The row on a menu whose host never offered it.

name: INS-glyph-stroke-filled
note: A stroke glyph filled solid.

name: INS-glyph-stroke-width-ignored
note: The face's own stroke ignored - the name layer's 1.6 drawn at the chat's 1.8.

name: INS-host-asks-an-old-relay
note: An ask sent to a relay that closes the socket for it.

name: INS-host-answer-for-anyone
note: Anyone's card drawn on the open profile.

name: INS-host-wait-never-said
note: A card that never comes waited on forever, with nothing said.

name: INS-host-asks-ungated
note: Every ask answered at once.

name: INS-host-f-does-not-close
old: if (profileWin?.isOpen()) { profileWin.hide(); return true; }   // INSPECT1: F again closes the profile, as it closes the F-menu
note: F with the profile up opens a menu over it.

name: INS-host-row-not-offered
note: The host never offers the row - on the card or on the plaque (the merge's one bag, peerActsFor).
